## History

Daniel was known for being odd, frequently throwing tantrums and refusing to get out of bed. While [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) were canvassing to raise money for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), they assisted him with baking a cake. In exchange for their help, Daniel gave them a subscription for the society.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P16](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0016), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P36](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0036), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P47](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0047), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P48](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0048)_
